arguments.query: select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents,b.client_reference,(select group_concat(c.charge_id||"|"||c.idempotency_key||"|"||c.state||"|"||c.amount_cents) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch,(select group_concat(p.idempotency_key||"|"||p.state||"|"||ifnull(p.final_state,"")||"|"||ifnull(p.settles_at_step,"")) from provider_ledger p where p.booking_id=b.booking_id) pl,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h from bookings b

select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents,b.client_reference,(select group_concat(c.charge_id||"|"||c.idempotency_key||"|"||c.state||"|"||c.amount_cents) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h from bookings b where b.status="pending"

select b.booking_id,b.status,c.charge_id,c.state,(select count(*) from outbox where status="pending") op from bookings b left join charges c on c.booking_id=b.booking_id where b.status<>"confirmed" or c.state<>"captured"
